name: battery_type_registration
title: Battery type setting and registration (AGM / size)
intent: Tells the Body computer which 12 V battery type and size is fitted so the charging logic matches it. Only needed when the new battery differs in type or capacity from the stored setting.
summary: Tells the Body computer which 12 V battery type and size is fitted so the charging logic matches it. Only needed when the new battery differs in type or capacity from the stored setting.
status_note: steps is EMPTY on purpose: no bytes, identifiers or procedures are invented. Fill steps only from the manufacturer's documented procedure and cite it in source.

session.note: bus and bitrate are the confirmed CAN-C values; the diagnostic session comes with the manufacturer's documented steps

read_back.label: No read method for the current value is known. The manufacturer must supply one so a before and after can be proven.

conditions: Only when the battery type or capacity changes. Same-type swap: no registration reported (docs/design/CUORE_ADJUSTMENTS_PLAN.md, outside forum reports).

preconditions.label: Only when the battery type or capacity changes. Same-type swap: no registration reported (docs/design/CUORE_ADJUSTMENTS_PLAN.md, outside forum reports).

verification_rule: Unknown until the manufacturer documents a read method. Nothing is claimed.
mes_function: CAN Setup -> Adjustments -> PROXI byte 63 bits 0-3
needs_from_manufacturer: The documented battery-type data (block, option names, allowed values) and the IBS (battery sensor) relearn rules.
A read method for the current value, so a before and after can be proven. The byte 63 value cannot be read by CUORE today.
The alignment step required afterwards and its preconditions.
Written authority for CUORE to write it, then the existing path: dry run, gate, typed consent, read-back, audit.

evidence.source: docs/design/CUORE_ADJUSTMENTS_PLAN.md Part 2 (MES path, classed coding, 'static configuration, not a live-learn routine')
docs/project/ALFAOBD_GAP.md section 1 item 12 (forum: an owner set AGM H8 in AlfaOBD then aligned in MES)
docs/maintenance/BATTERY_REGISTRATION_PLAN.md (owner reports the battery was replaced in December 2025 with a correct-size AGM, no registration done; whether byte 63 matches is unknown)

follow_up: PROXI alignment afterwards (docs/maintenance/BATTERY_REGISTRATION_PLAN.md; MES route per docs/design/CUORE_ADJUSTMENTS_PLAN.md Part 2).

risks.risk: Wrong type registered; forum reports on the effect on charging are mixed and unconfirmed.
Interrupted write can leave modules disagreeing (TCM P1500 limp-in recorded on this platform).

public_values.note: single-source forum figures, recorded for reference only, never to be written
public_values.detail: CAN Setup, PROXI byte 63, bits 0-3 (MES path per docs/design/CUORE_ADJUSTMENTS_PLAN.md). Forum figures: xxxx0001 = 80Ah 680A (EU default); xxxx0010 = 95Ah 800A (US default); H8 AGM = xxxx1011 (0x8B). Sources: https://www.giuliaforums.com/threads/what-are-proxi-parameters-for-agm-battery-on-giulia-2-2.65519/page-3 and https://giuliatech.com/t/multiecuscan-mes-popular-settings-compilation/80. Byte numbering is a vendor-tool index, not a published DID.
